case_number: 2024 INSC 478; CIVIL APPEAL NO.7247 OF 2024; CIVIL APPEAL NO.7248 OF 2024; CIVIL APPEAL NO.7249 OF 2024

parties.petitioner: Bombay Slum Redevelopment Corporation Private Limited

summary: Arbitration appeal vs remand order; scope of interference under Section 37(1)(c) of Arbitration Act narrower than Section 34; appeal as continuation of Section 34 proceedings; remand under Order XLI CPC inapplicable; High Court improperly remanded Section 34 petition without deciding appeal on merits; appellate powers strictly limited to confirming or setting aside award; detailed reasoning by Single Judge warranted final decision not remand; Arbitral Tribunal's award enforcement disputed.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XLI
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court's remand order set aside; matter not to be sent back; appeal to be finally decided on merits by High Court; interim arrangements continued for four weeks.
